mapper.select: SELECT r.rsr_id, r.room_id, r.number_people, r.rsr_name, r.user_id, r.rsr_status, r.rsr_phone_number, r.rsr_date, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, rm.price, a.address, a.longitude, a.latitude, rm.acm_id, a.acm_name, a.main_img, a.admin_phone_number FROM reservation r JOIN room rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN accommodation a ON rm.acm_id = a.acm_id WHERE r.rsr_id=#{rsr_id}
mapper.delete: delete from reservation where rsr_id=#{ rsr_id }
